quests.title: Read your weekly bills
quests.reason: Groceries, the grid, city water, and gas: see where the money goes before you change anything.

reward.line: Dale lends you his wheelbarrow and a pile of old bricks.

quests.title: Build two raised beds in the lawn
quests.reason: Lawn takes water and gives nothing back. Two beds of vegetables is a start.

quests.title: Add compost
quests.reason: Kitchen scraps become next season's bed food instead of trash.

reward.line: Dale drops off a bag of his coffee grounds.

quests.title: Put a 500 W panel and a power station on the porch
quests.reason: A small panel won't run the house, but it charges what you need through an outage.

reward.line: Dale pays you to show him how you wired it.

quests.title: Install a rain barrel
quests.reason: The beds want water in July. The roof is already catching it.

reward.line: Dale gives you his spare diverter kit.

quests.title: Weatherize the house
quests.reason: The cheapest heat is the heat you don't lose: air sealing and attic insulation cut heat loss by about 30%.

reward.line: Dale's caulk gun and a leftover roll of insulation come over the fence.

quests.title: Add six hens (check the lot rules)
quests.reason: Most towns allow a few hens and no rooster. Six lay about 27 eggs a week.

reward.line: Dale trades a bag of feed for a dozen eggs a week.

quests.title: Cut to a part-time job and see if the homestead covers the difference
quests.reason: Twenty fewer hours at work is twenty more at home, and a shorter commute. Watch cash and bills for four weeks.

reward.line: Dale, who retired early, says he's proud of you.
